title: Fridge
prompt: a kitchen fridge-freezer: open the door, put in food, the light comes on, the compressor runs when the door is left open; see-through shows the compressor, condenser coils, evaporator, capillary tube and thermostat
blurb: Open the door, stock the shelves and leave it open too long: watch the thermostat click the compressor on to pump the heat out through the coils at the back.
